index.def: CREATE INDEX idx_user_hold_quota_updated_at ON public.user_hold_quota USING btree (updated_at)

function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_quota_touch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

trigger.def: CREATE TRIGGER user_hold_quota_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON public.user_hold_quota FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_quota_touch()
